plugins.name: kudosity-sms
plugins.description: Send SMS and MMS messages, manage contact lists, and configure webhooks using the Kudosity messaging platform.

skills.name: create-list
skills.description: Create contact lists and add contacts to them on the Kudosity platform. Use when the user wants to create a new contact list, add recipients to a list, or manage list contacts for SMS campaigns.
headings: Step 2: Add Contacts to the List
skills.description_zh: 在Kudosity建立联系人名单并添加成员，支持SMS活动收件人和清单管理。

skills.name: send-mms
skills.description: Send MMS (multimedia) messages via the Kudosity platform. Use when the user wants to send a message with images, GIFs, videos, or audio to a recipient.
skills.description_zh: 通过Kudosity向收件人发送含图片、GIF、视频或音频的MMS多媒体消息。

skills.name: send-sms
skills.description: Send SMS messages via the Kudosity platform. Use when the user wants to send a text message to a single recipient or to a contact list. Supports scheduling, link tracking, and delivery callbacks.
headings: Option A: Send to a Single Recipient (V2 API)
Option B: Send to a List or Multiple Numbers (V1 API)
skills.description_zh: 通过Kudosity向单人或联系人名单发送SMS，支持排程、链接跟踪及投递回调。

skills.name: setup-webhook
skills.description: Create and manage webhooks on the Kudosity platform. Use when the user wants to receive notifications for SMS delivery status, inbound messages, MMS events, link hits, or opt-outs.
headings: Example: Create a webhook for SMS delivery status and inbound messages
Example: Create a webhook filtered to specific statuses
skills.description_zh: 在Kudosity创建管理Webhook，接收短信投递、入站消息、MMS事件、链接点击或退订通知。
